meta.name: product-sense-interview-answer
meta.description: Structure a spoken PM product-sense answer with assumptions, segmentation, pain-point prioritization, and MVP tradeoffs. Use when practicing design, improve, or build-next interview questions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 结构化回答产品面试中的设计、改进类问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在准备产品经理面试，需要练习结构化回答。
copy.tagline_en: Structure your PM product-sense interview answers with assumptions and tradeoffs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are preparing for PM interviews and need to practice structured answers.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你按照“澄清-理由-目标-细分-痛点-方案”六步结构，逐步构建产品感面试的口头回答，避免直接跳入解决方案。
howto.when: 当你练习产品设计、改进或“下一步做什么”类面试题时，例如说“如何改进YouTube？”或“为飞行焦虑者设计产品”。

say.text: 帮我练习回答：如何改进Google Maps的通勤体验？
say.note: Claude 会按六步结构引导你思考。

say.text: 设计一个产品，帮助有飞行焦虑的旅客。
say.note: Claude 会要求你澄清范围、细分用户等。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through a six-part answer spine (clarify, rationale, goal, segmentation, pain points, solution) to structure spoken product-sense interview answers, preventing solution-first thinking.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you practice product design, improvement, or 'what would you build next' interview questions, e.g., 'How would you improve YouTube?' or 'Design a product for travelers with flight anxiety.'

say_en.text: Help me practice answering: How would you improve Google Maps for commuters?
say_en.note: Claude will walk you through the six-part structure.

say_en.text: Design a product for travelers with flight anxiety.
say_en.note: Claude will ask you to clarify scope, segment users, etc.
